description: ol-duplicate-binder (issue #407/F8): the runtime's own comprehensionDuplicateBinder mirror of the checker rule — a `reduce` accumulator colliding with one of its destructuring item-binder's pattern names, reached through `execute()`, which since issue #815 runs `check()` before Phase 2, same as the checker-level `duplicate-binder-reduce-pattern-accumulator` fixture. Issue #815: `execute()` now runs Layer 1 and Layer 2 before Phase 2 and refuses a program carrying an `error`-severity finding (`spec/execution-model.md:659-664`), so no event is emitted and the diagnostic delivered here is the CHECK's. The runtime's own copy of the rule still exists and still runs — under the `runUnchecked` opt-out — and is collapsed into the check's by the de-duplication rule (`spec/execution-model.md:741-748`), which is why only one report survives and it reads `stage: "semantic"`.
